summary: A double-quoted value ending in an escaped backslash is mis-parsed because the closing quote is treated as escaped.

provenance.note: Evaluator-only. base_sha is the parent of the upstream fix; the fix is never reachable from the sealed clone.

reverse_apply_exceptions.godotenv-go-module: This base already has the three-line go.mod that godotenv-go-module's reference patch adds, so that patch reverses cleanly here. It is not an answer leak: the go-module task's answer is 'add the canonical go.mod', which every Go checkout reveals. The harmful direction (the go-module base containing this fixture's parser fix) is checked by the verifier and is clean.

reference.note: Evaluator-only. The verifier renders the reference patch from upstream: git diff --binary -M base_sha commit -- paths, per step.
